nodes.answer: By applying production-diffusion modelling to include subsoil fluxes.

nodes.question: What are some of the benefits of healthy soils?
nodes.answer: Healthy soils are associated with higher primary productivity, resilience to climate change, and play a pivotal role in food security and human health.
